"""Execute the prepared public-speech probe after the MLX experiment finishes."""
import hashlib,json,math,os,re,signal,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('Scripts').resolve()))
from model_files import inventory

def words(text):
    return re.findall(r"[A-Z0-9]+(?:'[A-Z0-9]+)?",text.upper().replace('’',"'"))

def errors(reference,actual):
    previous=list(range(len(actual)+1))
    for i,word in enumerate(reference,1):
        current=[i]
        for j,observed in enumerate(actual,1):
            current.append(min(previous[j]+1,current[j-1]+1,previous[j-1]+(word!=observed)))
        previous=current
    return previous[-1]

assert words("Hello, WORLD!")==['HELLO','WORLD']
assert errors(words('one two'),words('one'))==1
assert errors(words('one'),words('one two'))==1
assert errors(words('one'),words('two'))==1
assert errors([],words('one'))==1
assert errors(words("don't"),words('dont'))==1
if '--check-only' in sys.argv:
    print('WER normalization and insertion/deletion/substitution checks pass.');sys.exit(0)
active=subprocess.run(['ps','-p','95903','-o','command='],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert 'run_preservation.py' not in active.stdout,'Wait for the existing MLX training/evaluation driver to finish'
root=Path.cwd()
inputs=json.loads(Path('Models/evidence/public-speech-inputs-2026-09-17.json').read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for name,digest in {**inputs['buildSourceSHA256'],**inputs['retainedRunnerSHA256']}.items():assert sha(name)==digest,name
assert sha('.context/PublicSpeechAssetTests.swift')==inputs['probeSourceSHA256']
audio=root/'.build/public-speech-probe'
assert sha(audio/'fixtures.json')==inputs['fixturesSHA256']
for row in inputs['fixtures']:assert sha(audio/(row['id']+'.wav'))==row['wavSHA256']
pack=root/'Models/Artifacts/composition-adapter-development-pack'
output=root/'.build/public-speech-results.json'
assert not output.exists(),'Do not overwrite a previous probe'
files=[Path(__file__),Path('.context/PublicSpeechAssetTests.swift'),Path('Models/evidence/public-speech-inputs-2026-09-17.json'),audio/'fixtures.json',*[audio/(r['id']+'.wav') for r in inputs['fixtures']],Path('Packages/Recognition/Package.swift'),Path('Packages/Recognition/Package.resolved'),Path('Scripts/model_files.py'),Path('Scripts/privacy/deny-network.sb')]
files+=list(Path('Packages/Recognition/Sources').rglob('*.swift'))+list(Path('Packages/DictationCore/Sources').rglob('*.swift'))
identity={str(p):sha(p) for p in files}
models={name:inventory(pack/name) for name in ['recognition','vad']}
profile=str(root/'Scripts/privacy/deny-network.sb')
control='''import errno,socket
for family,address in [(socket.AF_INET,('127.0.0.1',9)),(socket.AF_INET6,('::1',9))]:
    with socket.socket(family) as client:
        try:client.connect(address)
        except OSError as error:assert error.errno==errno.EPERM,error
        else:raise RuntimeError('IP networking was allowed')
'''
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/sandbox-exec','-f',profile,sys.executable,'-c',control],check=True)
command=['/usr/bin/sandbox-exec','-f',profile,'xcrun','xctest','-XCTest',
         'RecognitionTests.PublicSpeechAssetTests/testRecordedHumanSpeechThroughProductionReplay',
         str(root/'.build/public-speech-runner/RecognitionTests.xctest')]
env={**os.environ,'POPTART_PUBLIC_SPEECH_PACK':str(pack),'POPTART_PUBLIC_SPEECH_AUDIO':str(audio),'POPTART_PUBLIC_SPEECH_OUTPUT':str(output)}
log=Path('.build/public-speech-run.log')
with log.open('w') as stream:
    process=subprocess.Popen(command,env=env,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
    try:status=process.wait(timeout=900)
    except BaseException:
        os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGKILL);process.wait();raise
assert identity=={str(p):sha(p) for p in files},'Source changed'
assert models=={name:inventory(pack/name) for name in ['recognition','vad']},'Models changed'
for name,digest in {**inputs['buildSourceSHA256'],**inputs['retainedRunnerSHA256']}.items():assert sha(name)==digest,name
rows=json.loads(output.read_text()) if output.exists() else []
assert len(rows)==16 and {r['id'] for r in rows}=={r['id'] for r in inputs['fixtures']},'Incomplete fixture coverage'
expected={r['id']:r for r in inputs['fixtures']}
for row in rows:
    fixture=expected[row['id']]
    assert row['reference']==fixture['reference'] and row['audioSeconds']==fixture['audioSeconds']
    assert type(row['final']) is bool and type(row['partialCount']) is int and row['partialCount']>=0
    assert type(row['partialCountBeforeRelease']) is int and 0<=row['partialCountBeforeRelease']<=row['partialCount']
    for field in ['finalizationMilliseconds','firstPartialMilliseconds','replayReleaseMilliseconds']:
        value=row.get(field)
        if field=='firstPartialMilliseconds' and value is None:
            assert row['partialCount']==0;continue
        assert type(value) in [float,int] and math.isfinite(value) and value>=0
    if row['partialCountBeforeRelease']>0:
        assert row['firstPartialMilliseconds']<row['replayReleaseMilliseconds']
    elif row.get('firstPartialMilliseconds') is not None:
        assert row['firstPartialMilliseconds']>=row['replayReleaseMilliseconds']
    reference,actual=words(row['reference']),words(row['transcript'])
    assert reference
    row.update(referenceWords=len(reference),wordErrors=errors(reference,actual),normalizedExact=reference==actual)
total=sum(r['referenceWords'] for r in rows);distance=sum(r['wordErrors'] for r in rows)
complete=status==0 and 'Executed 1 test' in log.read_text() and all(r['final'] and r['transcript'] for r in rows)
evidence=dict(status='Recorded-human-speech adapter diagnostic; no release-quality or latency gate claim.',
 executionComplete=complete,exitCode=status,inputs=inputs,sourceSHA256=identity,models=models,
 ipDenialControl='IPv4/IPv6 EPERM under the same sandbox profile before execution',ipDenialControlSource=control,
 command=command,rows=rows,referenceWords=total,wordErrors=distance,wordErrorRate=distance/total,
 normalizedExactUtterances=sum(r['normalizedExact'] for r in rows),
 utterancesWithPreReleasePartials=sum(r['partialCountBeforeRelease']>0 for r in rows),
 partialTimingOrigin='Monotonic instant captured before startRecording, including recognizer setup. Pre-release counts use receipt time strictly before replay completion/release.',
 normalization='Uppercase; curly apostrophe to ASCII; alphanumeric words with internal apostrophes. No number expansion, contraction rewriting, or reference-specific normalization.',
 hardware=subprocess.check_output(['/usr/sbin/sysctl','-n','machdep.cpu.brand_string'],text=True).strip(),
 limitations=inputs['limitations']+['Recognition-only replay, empty Personal Vocabulary,30second finalization allowance; no Cleanup, insertion, history, full privacy, live microphone or physicalM1 timing claim.'],
 probeSource=Path('.context/PublicSpeechAssetTests.swift').read_text(),driverSource=Path(__file__).read_text(),log=log.read_text())
Path('Models/evidence/public-speech-2026-09-17.json').write_text(json.dumps(evidence,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(executionComplete=complete,wordErrors=distance,referenceWords=total,wordErrorRate=distance/total)),flush=True)
if not complete:sys.exit(1)

import hashlib,json,shutil,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
probe=Path('.context/PublicSpeechAssetTests.swift')
target=Path('Packages/Recognition/Tests/RecognitionTests/PublicSpeechAssetTests.swift')
assert not target.exists()
files=[probe,Path('Packages/Recognition/Package.swift'),Path('Packages/Recognition/Package.resolved'),Path('Packages/DictationCore/Package.swift')]
for directory in ['Packages/Recognition/Sources','Packages/Recognition/Tests','Packages/DictationCore/Sources']:
 files+=sorted(Path(directory).rglob('*.swift'))
identity={str(p):sha(p) for p in files}
shutil.copyfile(probe,target)
try:
 with Path('.build/public-speech-build.log').open('w') as log:
  subprocess.run(['swift','build','--package-path','Packages/Recognition','--build-tests'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 assert target.read_bytes()==probe.read_bytes()
 assert identity=={str(p):sha(p) for p in files}
 root=Path('.build/public-speech-runner')
 for name in ['RecognitionTests.xctest','FluidAudio_FluidAudio.bundle']:
  shutil.rmtree(root/name)
  subprocess.run(['/bin/cp','-cR',str(Path('Packages/Recognition/.build/out/Products/Debug')/name),str(root/name)],check=True)
 metadata=Path('Models/evidence/public-speech-inputs-2026-09-17.json')
 record=json.loads(metadata.read_text())
 record['buildSourceSHA256']=identity
 record['probeSource']=probe.read_text()
 record['probeSourceSHA256']=sha(probe)
 record['buildCommand']='swift build --package-path Packages/Recognition --build-tests (temporary opt-in test source removed after build)'
 record['buildLog']=Path('.build/public-speech-build.log').read_text()
 record['buildDriverSource']=Path(__file__).read_text()
 record['swiftVersion']=subprocess.check_output(['swift','--version'],text=True)
 record['retainedRunnerSHA256']={str(f):sha(f) for f in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if f.is_file()}
 metadata.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
finally:
 target.unlink()
print('Probe rebuilt with source/pin hashes before and after compilation; retained runner refreshed.')

"""Select a small public read-speech probe before observing any recognition output."""
import hashlib,json,subprocess,tarfile,wave
from pathlib import Path
archive=Path('.build/librispeech-test-clean.tar.gz')
with archive.open('rb') as f:assert hashlib.file_digest(f,'md5').hexdigest()=='32fa31d27d2e1cad72775fee3f4849a9'
out=Path('.build/public-speech-probe')
assert not out.exists()
out.mkdir()
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
records=[]
with tarfile.open(archive) as corpus:
    def read(name):
        member=corpus.getmember(name)
        assert member.isfile() and member.size<10_000_000
        return corpus.extractfile(member).read()
    for name in ['LICENSE.TXT','README.TXT','SPEAKERS.TXT','CHAPTERS.TXT']:
        (out/name).write_bytes(read('LibriSpeech/'+name))
    people=[]
    for line in (out/'SPEAKERS.TXT').read_text().splitlines():
        if not line.strip() or line.startswith(';'):continue
        parts=[p.strip() for p in line.split('|',4)]
        if parts[2]=='test-clean':people.append(dict(id=int(parts[0]),sex=parts[1],name=parts[4]))
    selected=[]
    for sex in ['F','M']:
        selected.extend(sorted((p for p in people if p['sex']==sex),key=lambda p:p['id'])[:4])
    assert len(selected)==8
    for person in sorted(selected,key=lambda p:p['id']):
        names=sorted(m.name for m in corpus.getmembers() if m.isfile() and m.name.startswith(f"LibriSpeech/test-clean/{person['id']}/") and m.name.endswith('.flac'))[:2]
        assert len(names)==2
        for name in names:
            identifier=Path(name).stem
            assert all(c in '0123456789-' for c in identifier)
            source=out/(identifier+'.flac')
            source.write_bytes(read(name))
            chapter='-'.join(identifier.split('-')[:2])
            text=read(str(Path(name).parent/(chapter+'.trans.txt'))).decode()
            matches=[line.split(' ',1)[1] for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith(identifier+' ')]
            assert len(matches)==1
            audio=out/(identifier+'.wav')
            subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/afconvert','-f','WAVE','-d','LEI16',str(source),str(audio)],check=True)
            with wave.open(str(audio)) as w:
                assert w.getnchannels()==1 and w.getframerate()==16000 and w.getsampwidth()==2
                duration=w.getnframes()/w.getframerate()
                assert 0<duration<300
            records.append(dict(id=identifier,reference=matches[0],speaker=person,archiveMember=name,
                                flacSHA256=sha(source),wavSHA256=sha(audio),audioSeconds=duration))
assert len(records)==16 and len({r['id'] for r in records})==16
(out/'fixtures.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
evidence=dict(status='Prepared before inference; no recognition or release-quality claim.',
 source='https://www.openslr.org/12',download='https://openslr.trmal.net/resources/12/test-clean.tar.gz',
 upstreamChecksums='https://openslr.trmal.net/resources/12/md5sum.txt',
 archiveMD5='32fa31d27d2e1cad72775fee3f4849a9',archiveSHA256=sha(archive),license='CC-BY-4.0',
 licenseURL='https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/',licenseText=(out/'LICENSE.TXT').read_text(),
 attribution='LibriSpeech (c) 2014 Vassil Panayotov; LibriVox readers credited per fixture.',
 selection='First four numeric speaker IDs per F/M metadata group in test-clean; first two lexically sorted utterances per speaker. No output-based selection.',
 transformations='Decoded FLAC to signed16-bit mono WAV using macOS afconvert; original sample rate retained.',
 limitations=['Small ordered read-audiobook sample, not representative spontaneous Dictation or live microphone evidence.',
              'Upstream ASR training overlap is not established; this is an adapter execution probe, not an independent model benchmark.',
              'No Cleanup training data or frozen Cleanup evaluation labels changed.'],
 fixtures=records,fixturesSHA256=sha(out/'fixtures.json'),sourceCode=Path(__file__).read_text())
Path('Models/evidence/public-speech-inputs-2026-09-17.json').write_text(json.dumps(evidence,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(fixtures=len(records),speakers=len(selected),seconds=sum(r['audioSeconds'] for r in records),ids=[r['id'] for r in records])))
